headline: Relation Insurance Names Dave Tacha Chief Revenue Officer
summary: CHICAGO, September 16, 2026--Relation Insurance Services ("Relation") announced today that Dave Tacha has joined the company as Chief Revenue Officer. In this newly created role, Tacha will lead Relation's enterprise revenue strategy and work across its regions and business lines to accelerate organic growth, strengthen sales execution, and support producer recruitment and development.

headline: Mizuho Maintains Outperform on Arthur J. Gallagher, Lowers Price Target to $292
summary: Mizuho  analyst Yaron Kinar   maintains Arthur J. Gallagher (NYSE:AJG) with a Outperform and lowers the price target from $300 to $292.
